environment.build: production app and separate production runtime harness
environment.fixture: two generated populated run slots per profile; 400 feed entries per slot; 20 completed seasons and 100 wallet records per profile
environment.limitations: CPU throttling is not physical low-end hardware. Heap is JavaScript only; excludes native/GPU/process RAM. Runtime startup measures storage and store imports. App startup waits for the visible main menu; app resume waits for gameplay navigation. Warm HTTP cache; fresh browser context per observation. Synthetic bounded-history fixtures are not a substitute for a long-season gameplay trace.
